snippet.description:

Lula criticou a alternativa de flexibilização defendida pelo adversário e reforçou apoio à PEC que prevê 40 horas semanais sem redução salarial.

O presidente também defendeu maior participação da União na segurança pública por meio da PEC do setor, além de citar ações de inteligência em 138 unidades prisionais estratégicas no combate ao crime organizado.

snippet.title: I keep this mat by my desk for the days that never end 🌿
snippet.description:
Some days my feet clock out long before I do. That heavy, full feeling settles in around mid-afternoon and just stays there.

So I started keeping the mat nearby and stepping onto it whenever I need a pause. Bare feet, a few deep breaths, and the beads press into my soles — sharp at first, then softening into a warm tingle that travels upward. I stand there until my shoulders drop on their own.

When I step off, my feet feel lighter and my head feels clearer, like I gave myself a proper break without going anywhere.

Give your feet a few minutes of this and notice what shifts.

snippet.title: 台灣AV盛極而衰：中國市場如何催生這場成人片熱潮？－ BBC News 中文
snippet.description:
台灣被視為「亞洲唯一能合法拍攝無碼成人影片」的地區，並曾在2020年前後迎來產業快速擴張。

有AV演員向BBC中文表示，高峰時期全台片商超過20家，每月產出180至300支作品。學者估計，相關成人娛樂產業產值可達新台幣200億元。

然而，隨著大型片商「麻豆傳媒」於2026年突然停運，台灣成人影片產業的興衰再度受到關注。

多名從業者透露，產業在疫情期間快速成長，背後可能與中國市場需求、線上博弈廣告及灰色資金流入有關。近年隨著資金退潮及龍頭企業倒下，整個產業正面臨巨大挑戰。

BBC中文採訪多位AV女優、導演、製作公司員工及學者，探討台灣成人影片產業如何崛起、如何轉型，以及在缺乏明確監管下面對什麼亂象。
